description: Clinical archetypes abstracted from resident-authored seed cases. Queries resolve through local source-backed reference rows. Profiles differ before error injection.

clinical_profiles.followup_item: Primary care follow-up after collateral medication verification
clinical_profiles.context_note: The patient could not supply a reliable medication history at admission. A collateral home-medication list arrived later and was verified. Ibuprofen had already been stopped and was recorded separately from names that were still uncertain.
clinical_profiles.medrec_notes: At admission the patient could not provide a reliable medication history because of delirium. After cognition improved, a collateral list from family and pharmacy fill history was verified. Unknown names were not converted into discharge orders.
clinical_profiles.admission_reason: Admitted for delirium with an initially incomplete medication history.

consults.recommendation: Use the verified collateral medication list at discharge.

clinical_profiles.followup_item: Primary care medication-list follow-up
clinical_profiles.context_note: A later collateral list confirmed a continued statin.
clinical_profiles.medrec_notes: A later pharmacy fill history confirmed a continued statin. Incomplete information at admission is recorded as such.
clinical_profiles.admission_reason: Admitted for delirium; a verified statin was confirmed from collateral sources.

clinical_profiles.followup_item: Home-health and primary care medication-supply follow-up
clinical_profiles.context_note: Discharge planning includes home services. The verified list is the collateral regimen, including a diuretic identified after admission.
clinical_profiles.medrec_notes: After delirium improved, home services were arranged around the verified medication list.
clinical_profiles.admission_reason: Admitted for delirium with a later-verified home regimen and home-health needs.

clinical_profiles.followup_item: Memory-clinic follow-up to reassess pending therapeutic decision
clinical_profiles.context_note: A cognitive-enhancer start is deferred to outpatient confirmation. That pending decision is documented separately from unknown home medications.
clinical_profiles.pending_decision_text: Start of a cognitive-enhancer remains a pending therapeutic decision for memory-clinic confirmation and is not an unknown home medication.
clinical_profiles.admission_reason: Admitted for resolving delirium; a pending outpatient cognitive-therapy decision was recorded.

clinical_profiles.followup_item: Heart-failure clinic after diuresis
clinical_profiles.context_note: Congestion improved with inpatient diuresis. Daily weights and intake/output were used to judge euvolemia before discharge.

consults.recommendation: Continue the intended heart-failure and diuretic plan.

clinical_profiles.admission_reason: Admitted for acute heart-failure decompensation with congestion.

clinical_profiles.followup_item: Cardiology follow-up to reassess held therapy
clinical_profiles.context_note: Creatinine rose with congestion. Lisinopril was held during decongestion because of worsening renal function.

consults.recommendation: Continue the intended heart-failure and diuretic plan.

clinical_profiles.hold_reason: Held for rising creatinine during decongestion; intended to restart after renal recovery.
clinical_profiles.restart_plan: Resume lisinopril when creatinine is falling toward the prior baseline.
clinical_profiles.admission_reason: Admitted for decompensated heart failure with worsening renal function.

clinical_profiles.followup_item: Electrolyte and heart-failure follow-up
clinical_profiles.context_note: Diuresis was accompanied by potassium repletion. The intended outpatient diuretic dose is recorded.

imaging.finding: Pulmonary vascular congestion and interstitial edema.
Improved pulmonary edema compared with admission.

consults.recommendation: Continue the intended heart-failure and diuretic plan.

clinical_profiles.context_note: The outpatient diuretic plan was reviewed during the stay. The discharge list is the intended home regimen after that adjustment.

consults.recommendation: Continue the intended heart-failure and diuretic plan.

clinical_profiles.context_note: The patient is leaving with a planned parenteral antibiotic course, line precautions, and scheduled laboratory monitoring. A seven-day supply was arranged to cover therapy until infectious-disease follow-up.
